title: H.A.C.D. Site Evidence Record
description: One piece of site evidence (a survey, a capture, a utility letter, a public dataset query, a document) and the facts it states. ADR-001: evidence is context with a date, accuracy, licence and review state. It is never silently treated as exact, and it never overwrites a proposed or verified value; it can only source a missing input, corroborate one, or flag a conflict.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. 'ev-cb-usgs-3dep-elevation'. Provenance entries cite it.

source_type.description: What kind of thing the evidence is. A model_output is H.A.C.D.'s or another tool's own result: it can corroborate, never source.

title.description: Name of the document, dataset or capture.

locator.description: Where in it: page, tab, section, layer.

uri.description: Public address of the source. Leave out for private files; this repo is public.

captured_at.description: When the evidence was captured or queried (not when it was imported).

crs.description: Coordinate reference system of 'location' and of any geometry, e.g. 'EPSG:4326'.

location.description: The point the evidence describes, in 'crs'. Null only for evidence with no spatial content.

kind.description: measured: the source reports it. stated: the publisher states a typical figure. nominal: a convention, e.g. the sampling grid. unknown: nobody says; this is a valid answer, a missing field is not.

licence.description: Terms the evidence may be used under.

chain_of_custody.description: Every hand the evidence passed through, oldest first.

confidence.description: How far a reader should lean on it. Say why in 'notes' when low.

revalidate_by.description: After this date the evidence can no longer source an input until someone revalidates it.

permitted_uses.description: Only 'scenario_input' lets a fact fill a Scenario input that has no provenance.

path.description: Scenario path the fact speaks to, e.g. 'site.lat'. A path the Scenario does not have is kept as evidence and reported.

unit.description: Unit as the source states it; null for flags and names.

locator.description: Where this one fact sits in the source, and any arithmetic used to transcribe it.
